ISTP>INTJ.title: Someone who grows hands-on answers into long-term plans.
ISTP>INTJ.body: Recharging in time alone to think, and deciding things by clear logic — that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the lightness to touch and test things for real, and the power to see years ahead and map out a path. Something you tried on a whim often turns out to be part of a bigger plan. You move forward by going back and forth between small experiments and a long blueprint.
ISTP>INTJ.say: "Let's just build one and see. …And how we'll use it three years from now? Already decided."
ISTP>INTJ.do: You tinker with tools on the weekend to build a prototype, then spend weeknight evenings putting it into a spreadsheet and planning the next upgrade.
ISTP>INTJ.worry: The more you plan ahead, the more the fun of just trying things on the spot seems to fade. Some days you freeze, torn between sticking to the plan and following the idea that just hit you.
ISTP>INTJ.karai: Line one of your ten-year plan is usually "just mess with it first."

ISTP>INTP.title: Someone who takes systems apart with both hands and head.
ISTP>INTP.body: Getting your energy back from time alone, thinking things through logically, and moving freely without being tied down by rules — these are the same in your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can both handle real things in front of you to see how they work, and imagine theories and possibilities no one can see yet. Put a broken machine in front of you, and you start thinking about how to fix it and "why was it built like this in the first place?" at the same time.
ISTP>INTP.say: "Take this screw out and it'll work. …Actually, there was a totally different way to build this, right?"
ISTP>INTP.do: You start fixing a home appliance and end up researching the history of how it works until midnight.
ISTP>INTP.worry: Your thoughts spread so wide that by the time you start using your hands, your interest has already moved on. The moment you understand something, you're satisfied — and you often forget to explain it to anyone.
ISTP>INTP.karai: You say "Ah, got it," and then explain absolutely nothing to anyone.

ISTP>ENTJ.title: Someone who leads big goals with quiet skill.
ISTP>ENTJ.body: Deciding things by clear logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both sides of several things: quietly sharpening your skills alone and gathering people to lead them, an eye for the facts in front of you and an eye for what's ahead, lightness on your feet and a talent for planning. In meetings you lay out the direction with confidence, while quietly handling the hardest job yourself.
ISTP>ENTJ.say: "This is the direction. Everyone, follow me. …Oh, and this part? I'll take care of it tonight."
ISTP>ENTJ.do: After finishing the team's plan, you head out to the site alone to check the real thing with your own eyes.
ISTP>ENTJ.worry: When you're stuck in the leader role for a while, you lose your time to work alone with your hands, and your battery suddenly dies. Even when you know handing things off is faster, you can't shake the feeling that doing it yourself is safer.
ISTP>ENTJ.karai: Your instructions are brilliant, but it usually ends with "Never mind, I'll just do it myself."

ISTP>ENTP.title: Someone who finds new paths with busy hands and a quick tongue.
ISTP>ENTP.body: Thinking logically and adapting flexibly to the moment are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the focus to test how things work on your own and the energy to spin out idea after idea while talking with people. You can also see both solid, touchable facts and possibilities that haven't taken shape yet — so you never stop at "all talk" or "all doing."
ISTP>ENTP.say: "Wouldn't it be fun if we did it like this? …No, wait — let me build one first, then we'll talk."
ISTP>ENTP.do: An idea that got everyone excited in casual chat? By that night, you've turned it into something real, on your own.
ISTP>ENTP.worry: Talking with people lights your fire, but too much of it wears you out and makes you want to hide at home. Your hands can never keep up with how many ideas you have.
ISTP>ENTP.karai: Your count of "I just thought of something fun" and your count of finished things don't match. At all.

ISTP>INFJ.title: Someone who calmly looks out for where people are headed.
ISTP>INFJ.body: Building up your strength in time alone is the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both sides of three things: an eye that sees facts as they are and one that reads what they'll mean later, deciding by logic and caring about people's feelings, moving lightly and planning ahead. You don't talk much, yet you have what someone needs ready before they even get stuck. That's your quiet way of helping.
ISTP>INFJ.say: "I figured this would be a problem next month. …So, here — already fixed it."
ISTP>INFJ.do: While listening to someone's problem, you build a solution in your head, and the next day you quietly hand them the tools they need.
ISTP>INFJ.worry: You think so much about the other person's feelings that you hesitate to give the logical answer. While worrying about the future, you let the task in front of you slide, and it disappoints you.
ISTP>INFJ.karai: Your kindness is so fast that people miss their chance to say thank you. Every single time.

ISTP>INFP.title: Someone whose skilled hands give shape to the scenes in their heart.
ISTP>INFP.body: Recharging in time alone and doing things your own way rather than by the rules are the same in your temperament and your character. Added to that, you have both the precise skill to handle things and the imagination to picture worlds that don't exist yet, plus both cool logic and a gentle heart for feelings. You get passionate talking about a work you love, yet your hands stay perfectly calm when you make things. That mix gives everything you create its own special flavor.
ISTP>INFP.say: "This color kind of makes me want to cry. …Anyway, if you're painting it, this brush size is best."
ISTP>INFP.do: When a keepsake breaks, before you even feel sad you're looking up how to fix it — and you give it back stronger than before.
ISTP>INFP.worry: When you choose with your heart, the logic doesn't catch up later, and that leaves you uneasy. You're not good at putting what you care about into words, so it often never reaches the people around you.
ISTP>INFP.karai: The hand that just wiped away your happy tears is already holding a tool.

ISTP>ENFJ.title: Someone who cheers people on — and quietly gets to work with their own hands.
ISTP>ENFJ.body: You're a warm leader who believes in people's potential and brings everyone together with encouragement. You also have a craftsman's side that loves working quietly with your hands and solving the actual problem in front of you. That's why you don't stop at words — you can really lend a hand to someone who's struggling. You have both a warm heart and calm, skilled hands.
ISTP>ENFJ.say: "You've all got this! …And that broken bit over there? I'll fix it."
ISTP>ENFJ.do: After giving the team a pep talk, you stay behind in the empty room, quietly finishing the fiddly work.
ISTP>ENFJ.worry: Since you're often out in front of people, you don't get enough quiet time to lose yourself in something alone. You're the one who puts feelings into words for others, yet your own feelings are hard to say.
ISTP>ENFJ.karai: After a fiery speech, what you really want is to go fiddle with your tools alone.

ISTP>ENFP.title: Someone who shares their curiosity with people and tools alike.
ISTP>ENFP.body: Moving lightly with the flow of the moment is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both sides of three things: focusing alone to check things and getting fired up with people, an eye for solid facts and an eye for widening possibilities, cool logic and a warm heart for feelings. One minute you're chatting away, the next you've gone quiet and started building something. That switch is part of your charm, too.
ISTP>ENFP.say: "Wait, that's amazing! Let's do it! …Hold on, let me check if we have enough materials."
ISTP>ENFP.do: On a camping trip you're the most excited one there — and somehow you end up handling the campfire and all the gear repairs.
ISTP>ENFP.worry: After a fun chat you suddenly want to be alone, and people worry, "Are you mad?" You want to do so many things that you often move on before finishing one.
ISTP>ENFP.karai: That plan you started on a whim? You're doing all the behind-the-scenes work for it. Alone.

ISTP>ISTJ.title: Someone who keeps sharpening solid skills with steady routines.
ISTP>ISTJ.body: Recharging alone, relying on facts, and deciding by logic are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the ability to adapt on the fly and the ability to follow set steps carefully. Normally you move forward reliably, right on schedule — but the moment trouble hits, you can close the manual and respond to what's actually happening.
ISTP>ISTJ.say: "We'll start at ten, as planned. …Well, if something breaks, I'll just fix it on the spot."
ISTP>ISTJ.do: Your toolbox is perfectly organized, yet when you're out you cleverly make do with whatever's at hand.
ISTP>ISTJ.worry: You're good at following rules, but in places with too many of them you suddenly can't breathe. You can't find the balance between doing things properly and doing them your way, so your days off end up either packed or totally empty.
ISTP>ISTJ.karai: You're trying very hard to stick to a schedule that literally says "be flexible."

ISTP>ISFJ.title: Someone whose handy skills support everyone's daily life.
ISTP>ISFJ.body: Recharging in time alone and relying on facts and experience are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both cool logic and a gentle heart for others' feelings, both quick, light action and careful preparation. If someone in your family gets a flat bike tire, you fix it without a word — and tidy up where the pump goes while you're at it. You show care with your hands more than with words.
ISTP>ISFJ.say: "It's getting cold, so take this. …Oh, let me fix that zipper real quick."
ISTP>ISFJ.do: You handle little problems at work before anyone asks, and leave a small note so the next person won't get confused.
ISTP>ISFJ.worry: Because you handle requests so easily, you can never find a reason to say no. Caught between wanting to get things done fast and wanting to put others first, your own time keeps shrinking.
ISTP>ISFJ.karai: You can fix everyone else's stuff, but your own exhaustion stays unrepaired.

ISTP>ESTJ.title: Someone with hands-on skill and the power to bring people together.
ISTP>ESTJ.body: Relying on facts and deciding by logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the focus to hone your skills alone and the drive to stand in front and organize people, plus both flexible, in-the-moment action and the ability to plan things out and see them through. You're good at giving directions, but people count on you most when something goes wrong on site. Your mouth and your hands are both always busy.
ISTP>ESTJ.say: "Here's how we'll split the roles. …And if there's trouble, send it my way. I'll come look right away."
ISTP>ESTJ.do: Put in charge of a neighborhood event, you spend the day itself running around fixing broken equipment on your own.
ISTP>ESTJ.worry: The more you're asked to lead, the less time you get to work quietly alone. You want others to stick to the plan, yet you yourself want to act on impulse — and you wonder if that's fair.
ISTP>ESTJ.karai: The person who said "Don't go off on your own" is the one going off on their own the most.

ISTP>ESFJ.title: Someone who calmly keeps everyone comfortable.
ISTP>ESFJ.body: Relying on the facts and experience in front of you is the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both sides of three things: focusing alone and enjoying being with people, cool logic and a kind heart that reads everyone's feelings, lightness and thoughtful planning. At gatherings you put everyone at ease, and when a problem comes up, you fix it without changing your expression. You're the kind of host people feel safe with.
ISTP>ESFJ.say: "Everyone got enough to drink? …Oh, that light's not working. Let me go check."
ISTP>ESFJ.do: At a home party you serve food matched to everyone's tastes, while quietly fixing the wobbly chair.
ISTP>ESFJ.worry: While looking after everyone, you lose your quiet time alone and suddenly feel drained. Torn between saying what's right and keeping the mood, you end up saying nothing.
ISTP>ESFJ.karai: After taking care of everyone, the part you enjoy most is the walk home alone.

ISTP>ISTP.title: Someone who trusts their own hands and eyes, and quietly carves their own path.
ISTP>ISTP.body: Your temperament and your character are the same combination. Checking things with your own hands, thinking them through logically, and moving freely without being tied down by rules — these have grown steadily in you since childhood. Because you know your own way so clearly, you really shine where people trust you to handle things, and in places that micromanage you, you tend to get worn out without knowing why.
ISTP>ISTP.do: Before anyone has even opened the manual, you've already finished putting it together.
ISTP>ISTP.worry: You're not good at putting feelings into words, so people often say, "I can't tell what you're thinking." The cause of your tiredness is often not you, but a place where you can't move freely.
ISTP>ISTP.karai: Someone asks "You okay?", you say "Yeah," and that's the end of the conversation.

ISTP>ISFP.title: Someone who adds a soft touch of feeling to steady, skilled hands.
ISTP>ISFP.body: Recharging in time alone, relying on facts, and adapting to the moment are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both cool logic and a sense that values feelings and beauty. You use tools with precision, yet when it's time to finish, you suddenly get particular about color and texture. You can make one piece that's both easy to use and lovely to have around.
ISTP>ISFP.say: "Strength-wise, it's fine. …But the corners would be cuter a little rounder, right?"
ISTP>ISFP.do: You build your own shelf with measurements that fit perfectly, then pick little decorations to match the wood.
ISTP>ISFP.worry: Even when logic tells you something is right, you can't move if your heart isn't in it. When you give someone your opinion, you keep wondering whether you sounded cold.
ISTP>ISFP.karai: "I'm not picky about it," says the person matching even the screw colors.

ISTP>ESTP.title: Someone whose hands-on skill shines among people, too.
ISTP>ESTP.body: Relying on facts, deciding by logic, and moving lightly with the moment are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the focus to hone your skills alone and the energy you get from diving in among people. In a lively crowd you're the most up-for-anything one there, and on your own you quietly master your craft. Your speed has real skill behind it.
ISTP>ESTP.say: "Okay, let's go! …Oh, let me just check the tire pressure first."
ISTP>ESTP.do: When trouble hits on an outing with friends, you're already moving before anyone else starts talking it over.
ISTP>ESTP.worry: Being with people is fun, but after a while you suddenly need time alone. You move so fast that people sometimes say, "Talk to us first!"
ISTP>ESTP.karai: Your motto is "Less thinking, more doing" — and then you hold a solo review meeting when you get home.

ISTP>ESFP.title: Someone who enjoys every bit of the moment with clever hands and a bright spirit.
ISTP>ESFP.body: Relying on the facts in front of you and adapting to the moment are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the focus to work alone and the energy you get from being with people, plus both cool logic and a warm heart that cares about everyone's feelings. On a trip, you're the one hyping everyone up — and when the car won't start, you calmly fix it. You can show fun and dependability at the same time.
ISTP>ESFP.say: "Wow, this place is amazing! Let's take a picture! …Huh, the tripod screw's loose. Hang on."
ISTP>ESFP.do: The day after playing all out with friends at a festival, you're alone at home, totally absorbed in rearranging your room.
ISTP>ESFP.worry: The day after a fun time with people, you're wiped out and don't want to talk to anyone. You hesitate between saying what you really think and keeping the fun going.
ISTP>ESFP.karai: You're the life of the party, yet somehow you end up in the corner fiddling with the sound system.

ISFP>INTJ.title: Someone who turns the beauty their heart picks into a long-term blueprint.
ISFP>INTJ.body: Building up energy in time alone is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both sides of three things: a sense that savors what feels good right here and now and an eye that sees far ahead, choosing with your heart and deciding by logic, lightness and planning. You don't let your love for something end as a passing whim — you turn it into a path you can follow for years until it's done.
ISFP>INTJ.say: "I really love this color scheme. …So I made a plan to redo my whole room in it by next year."
ISFP>INTJ.do: You've turned redecorating your room into a year-long, step-by-step plan, and you're working through it bit by bit.
ISFP>INTJ.worry: Making a plan calms you, but as you follow it, the feeling of "I love this" starts to fade. When people ask why you chose something by feel, you get stuck for words.
ISFP>INTJ.karai: Your "I just kinda like it" comes with a five-year plan attached.

ISFP>INTP.title: Someone who digs deep into what they love with logic.
ISFP>INTP.body: Recharging in time alone and moving at your own pace without being tied down by rules are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a sense that savors texture and color and a mind that thinks about unseen systems, plus both a gentle heart for feelings and calm logic. When you hear music you love, your heart moves — and at the same time, you start wondering, "Why does this sound move me?"
ISFP>INTP.say: "I love this song. …Can I take a sec to figure out why?"
ISFP>INTP.do: You start looking up how a little item you like was made, and before you know it you're reading about the history of its materials.
ISFP>INTP.worry: Sometimes you overthink what you feel and can't simply enjoy it anymore. You don't share your thoughts until they're sorted, so people often assume you're not thinking about anything.
ISFP>INTP.karai: By the time you finish explaining why it moved you, the other person is no longer moved.

ISFP>ENTJ.title: Someone with the strength to lead and a delicate, sensitive heart.
ISFP>ENTJ.body: You're a decisive leader who sets goals and pulls people forward. You also have a delicate side that treasures your own senses and quietly savors the people and beautiful things in front of you. That's why your decisions carry care for people, not just numbers. With both strength and kindness, you can move people forward.
ISFP>ENTJ.say: "The goal is end of the month — let's decide up to here today. …Before that, how about a short break, everyone?"
ISFP>ENTJ.do: After running a meeting briskly, you carefully finish the cover of the handout — and only the cover — in your favorite color.
ISFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you lead from the front, the less time you have to lose yourself in what you love. When you have to speak firmly to get things moving, you keep worrying afterward whether you hurt someone.
ISFP>ENTJ.karai: On a day of tough orders, the one reflecting hardest that night is the one who gave them.

ISFP>ENTP.title: Someone who expands what they feel by talking and trying.
ISFP>ENTP.body: Adapting flexibly to the moment is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both sides of three things: quietly savoring things alone and getting lively in conversation, sensing what's right in front of you and picturing new possibilities, a gentle heart for feelings and sharp logic. You read how people feel, and before you know it you've rolled the conversation in a totally new direction.
ISFP>ENTP.say: "Hmm, that's kind of sad for them. …Oh, but what if we flipped it and did this?"
ISFP>ENTP.do: While listening to a friend's worries, somehow you end up inventing a new game.
ISFP>ENTP.worry: The more fun you have talking, the more drained you are afterward, wanting to shut yourself away. After saying too much in a debate, you replay it at night, thinking about how the other person felt.
ISFP>ENTP.karai: You say "Either's fine with me," but in your head you've already lined up three counterarguments.

ISFP>INFJ.title: Someone who deepens kindness with quiet foresight.
ISFP>INFJ.body: Recharging in time alone and deciding with care for people's feelings are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a sense that savors this very moment and the ability to read what things will mean later, plus both easygoing lightness and calm foresight. You notice a friend's small changes right away and quietly stay by their side — while already thinking about what would make things easier for them down the road.
ISFP>INFJ.say: "Let's take it easy today. …But let's get ready for that thing next week together, okay?"
ISFP>INFJ.do: As you set out seasonal flowers, you've already decided what to display at this time next year.
ISFP>INFJ.worry: You think so far ahead for others that your own feelings get pushed to the back. Even on days you want to go with your mood, you end up adding plans "for later."
ISFP>INFJ.karai: You'll stand by someone's worries for the next ten years, yet you haven't told anyone your own.

ISFP>INFP.title: Someone who listens closely to the voice of the heart.
ISFP>INFP.body: Recharging in time alone, valuing feelings, and moving at your own pace are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a sense that truly takes in the colors and sounds in front of you, and an imagination that pictures worlds not yet formed. A tiny flower you spot on a walk gives you a whole story. You can treasure both the beauty of what's here and the beauty of what isn't yet.
ISFP>INFP.say: "This sunset is lovely. …Feels like a story from some faraway land is about to begin."
ISFP>INFP.do: In your favorite notebook, you take turns writing diary entries and made-up stories.
ISFP>INFP.worry: The higher your ideals, the lonelier the gap with reality feels. There are so many things you want to treasure that you can't decide which to choose.
ISFP>INFP.karai: In your imagination you can do anything. In real life, you agonize for an hour over calling to book a table.

ISFP>ENFJ.title: Someone who stays close and gently gives people a push.
ISFP>ENFJ.body: Deciding with care for people's feelings is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both sides of three things: settling your heart alone and getting energy among people, a sense that savors the present and an eye that sees ahead, easygoing lightness and the ability to plan. You stay close to the feelings of the person in front of you, while quietly clearing a path so they can take that first step.
ISFP>ENFJ.say: "I totally get how you feel. …So let's try getting this far together by next week."
ISFP>ENFJ.do: You drop off snacks a down friend might like — and leave having planned the next fun thing together, too.
ISFP>ENFJ.worry: When you're the cheerleader for too long, you lose time to do what you love alone, and your heart wears thin. Some days your mood can't keep up with the plans you made for everyone.
ISFP>ENFJ.karai: You're everyone's emotional support team, but your own calendar is completely blank.

ISFP>ENFP.title: Someone who shares the things they love and grows them with others.
ISFP>ENFP.body: Valuing feelings and going with the flow are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the ability to enjoy things quietly alone and the energy you get from sharing them with others, plus both an eye for what feels good right now and an eye for new possibilities. Some days you savor your favorite café alone; other days you bring friends, and the talk of "next, let's try that place" goes on forever.
ISFP>ENFP.say: "I love this place so much! Want to come with everyone next time? …Actually, maybe I want to come alone."
ISFP>ENFP.do: Every time you find a cute little thing you send a photo, and somehow three new plans for your next day off appear.
ISFP>ENFP.worry: On the way home after a fun time, you're thrown by how suddenly you want to be alone. New favorites keep piling up, and your heart moves on before you can dig into one.
ISFP>ENFP.karai: The very day you decide to stay home is the day you send out the most fun invitation yourself.

ISFP>ISTJ.title: Someone who protects a soft sensitivity with solid steps.
ISFP>ISTJ.body: Recharging in time alone and valuing the facts and experience in front of you are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a kindness that chooses with the heart and a calm that decides by logic, plus both free, light movement and the integrity to keep your word. In your precise work, little touches of care and a beautiful finish shine through. You deliver trust and comfort together.
ISFP>ISTJ.say: "I'll hand it in on time. …Oh, and I changed just the cover color to match the season."
ISFP>ISTJ.do: You keep your household budget accurate to the last cent, and put your favorite stickers in the corners of the pages.
ISFP>ISTJ.worry: On days you put being right first, you lie awake wondering whether you left someone's feelings behind. While following the rules, you realize you've been putting the things you love on hold.
ISFP>ISTJ.karai: So meticulous — except for your stationery habit, which never stays on budget.

ISFP>ISFJ.title: Someone who brings comfort to the everyday lives around them.
ISFP>ISFJ.body: Recharging in time alone, valuing facts and experience, and caring about people's feelings are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the lightness to move with your mood and the ability to think ahead and prepare properly. Usually you support family and friends with smooth planning, and on days off you wander wherever you like. You have both the power to support others and the power to fill yourself up.
ISFP>ISFJ.say: "I got tomorrow's stuff ready too. …So today, I'm just gonna wander out for a bit."
ISFP>ISFJ.do: You make everyone's lunches the night before, and on the day itself you enjoy a detour picked on a whim.
ISFP>ISFJ.worry: The more carefully you prepare, the guiltier you feel about free, easy time. While fitting into other people's schedules, you tend to forget what you wanted to do.
ISFP>ISFJ.karai: You carry spares for everything everyone else forgets — and left your own umbrella at home.

ISFP>ESTJ.title: Someone who moves things forward firmly, with kind eyes.
ISFP>ESTJ.body: Relying on the facts and experience in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both sides of three things: settling your heart alone and bringing people together, kindness that reads feelings and strength that decides by logic, lightness and a knack for planning. You keep things on schedule, and still quietly check in on anyone who looks tired. You're an organizer with both firmness and warmth.
ISFP>ESTJ.say: "Deadline's Friday, no changes. …But if it's getting to be too much, tell me early, okay?"
ISFP>ESTJ.do: You make a minute-by-minute schedule for an event, and on the day people also compliment your eye for decorations.
ISFP>ESTJ.worry: The clearer your instructions, the more you lie awake wondering if you said it too harshly. The longer you're the organizer, the more you miss time alone with the things you love.
ISFP>ESTJ.karai: The sterner your face that day, the more likely you buy yourself something cute on the way home.

ISFP>ESFJ.title: Someone who brings quiet thoughtfulness into the group.
ISFP>ESFJ.body: Valuing facts and experience and caring about people's feelings are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the ability to spend time quietly alone and the energy you get among people, plus both lightness in the moment and the ability to think ahead and prepare. At gatherings you pay close attention so everyone feels at home, and back home you sink into your favorite music alone. That switch is what keeps you going.
ISFP>ESFJ.say: "Everyone's seat is all set. …Oh, I might sneak out a little early, though."
ISFP>ESFJ.do: You start preparing birthday party decorations a week ahead, and afterward you take the leftover flowers home to your room.
ISFP>ESFJ.worry: You love doing things for everyone, but keep it up and you suddenly want to be alone. When turning down an invitation, you overthink whether you'll let them down.
ISFP>ESFJ.karai: The day after organizing the perfect get-together, you turn off every notification on your phone.

ISFP>ISTP.title: Someone with a feeling heart and sure, skilled hands.
ISFP>ISTP.body: Recharging in time alone, relying on facts, and adapting to the moment are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a sense that values feelings and beauty and the power to judge calmly by logic. When something you love moves you, you can also work out with your hands how to make it even better. Your sensitivity comes with real skill.
ISFP>ISTP.say: "This shape is beautiful. …If I shave a bit off here, it'll be easier to hold."
ISFP>ISTP.do: You repair your favorite old chair yourself, keeping all its worn-in charm.
ISFP>ISTP.worry: After calmly saying what's right, you replay it again and again, wondering if you hurt the person. You want to choose with your heart, but logic gets there first and you can't just be happy.
ISFP>ISTP.karai: People call you "distant," but the gifts you make with those hands usually get happy tears.

ISFP>ISFP.title: Someone who has kept growing what they love, straight and true.
ISFP>ISFP.body: Your temperament and your character are the same combination. A sense for what feels good, a gentle way of staying close to people, and the lightness to move at your own pace — these have grown in you without wavering. Because you know yourself so clearly, you bloom in places filled with things you love, and where you're rushed or dismissed, you tend to lose energy without knowing why.
ISFP>ISFP.say: "Yeah, this one. I can't really explain why, though."
ISFP>ISFP.do: On an ordinary walk home, you catch the scent of the season and take the long way back.
ISFP>ISFP.worry: It takes you time to put your feelings into words, and you often end up swallowing them unsaid. The cause of your tiredness is often not you, but a place that asks you to move at a pace that doesn't fit.
ISFP>ISFP.karai: You say "Anywhere's fine," yet you remember the restaurant that didn't get picked for quite a while.

ISFP>ESTP.title: Someone who savors every bit of the moment with feeling and action.
ISFP>ESTP.body: Relying on the facts in front of you and moving lightly with the moment are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the ability to savor things quietly alone and the energy you get from diving in among people, plus both a gentle heart for feelings and the power to decide quickly by logic. On a trip, you jump right into any spot that catches your heart, and even when trouble hits, you calmly change the plan.
ISFP>ESTP.say: "This place has such a nice vibe! Let's go in! …Oh, if it's packed, I'll check the place around back first."
ISFP>ESTP.do: You enjoy an outing with friends to the fullest, then back home you slowly look through the photos alone.
ISFP>ESTP.worry: Something you decided in the heat of the moment snags later: "Did I think about how they felt?" When the busy, noisy times go on, you suddenly feel worn out from having no time alone.
ISFP>ESTP.karai: First to make a move — and the quietest one on the way home.

ISFP>ESFP.title: Someone who shares comfort and spreads it among people.
ISFP>ESFP.body: Valuing the facts in front of you, caring about feelings, and going with the flow are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the ability to enjoy things quietly alone and the energy to light up among people. In lively places you make everyone smile, and in your time alone you sink deep into what you love. You have both the power to spread fun to others and the power to savor things deeply on your own.
ISFP>ESFP.say: "Let's all go, it'll be so fun! …And when I get home, I'll look at today's photos by myself."
ISFP>ESFP.do: You throw everything into celebrating a friend's birthday, and the next day you watch your favorite movies in your room all day.
ISFP>ESFP.worry: The more time you spend in fun places, the harder the tiredness hits afterward. You can't say no to invitations, so you easily run short of time alone.
ISFP>ESFP.karai: You're the one who says "Let's hang out again!" the most — but the next message usually comes from them.
